name: Hornero System Monitor
description: System Monitor 3.0 on Hornero Signal: a CPU oscilloscope from the shared Telemetry history, segmented meter rows for CPU, memory, GPU and storage with a user threshold, and peak/average readouts. Read-only.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Deprecated: Retired: System Insight is the maintained system instrument (CPU oscilloscope, meters, temperatures, per-core strips) with typed settings and a desktop surface.

PluginKit 3 on Hornero Signal: oscilloscope and segmented meters over the shared Telemetry history; Material tokens and the hand-drawn sparkline are gone. The sampleSeconds setting and Clear history button are removed (history is the shared 120-sample window).
Dashboard card on the shared System facade: 1.x bars plus session history sparkline, peak/average, high-load alert, typed settings, host-context layout and Spanish catalog.
Dashboard card with CPU, memory, GPU and storage usage bars from the PluginKit System service.

deprecation.message: Retired: System Insight is the maintained system instrument (CPU oscilloscope, meters, temperatures, per-core strips) with typed settings and a desktop surface.

warnPercent.description: Usage percent at or above which a row is flagged as high. Adds an alert chip only; 1.x had no threshold.

showTemperatures.description: Show CPU/GPU temperatures when the System service reports them (the 1.x behaviour).

showHistory.description: Show the CPU oscilloscope and peak/average readouts from the shared telemetry history.
